thesis: The site is the shelf tag: every section is a field on a batch label, and scrolling reads the tag line by line so the visitor can compare before they drive.

signature.name: batch-tags
signature.summary: Every section is filed under a batch tag with a code (B-01 Strength, B-02 Test date, B-03 Price per gram, B-04 Tax, B-05 Pickup) and a printed date; numbers are set in DM Mono and underlined in amber when explained. Hook: data-sw-signature='batch-tag'.

palette.family: Lab White + Graphite + Test-Tube Amber + Sample-Bag Blue

motion.intro: Hero tag prints line by line like a label printer, ending with the batch code stamp; ≤1.0s.
stories: Price-per-gram counter recalculates as sizes step from eighth to ounce with a shrinking bar.
COA lines highlight one by one in the lab section on scroll.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX on links and tag anchors.
